reviewer: Second assistant pass by evaluation-author agent
review_type: Assistant-only, unblinded; not independent human or independent-author review
method: Read raw tool arguments and locally rederived query compilation, Pareto dominance, sorting/tie boundaries, comparison arithmetic and snapshot row/note binding without calling grade_contract or ToolBox. This reviewer also authored the evaluation harness; a separate core agent independently checked fixture expectations.
scope: Only the predeclared synthetic contracts, not general semantic correctness or real experimental outcomes
interpretation: First-attempt assessment inspects the originally returned first message; harness first-attempt metrics locally replay that same message with zero provider requests. Replay is not a new model sample or paid call.
Development A/B tasks are known v0.8 regressions and excluded from new-fixture totals.

Any v2 advantage observed here is already present on first proposals; no v2 repair was exercised in these draws. Version-specific repair guidance remains tested by deterministic tests, not demonstrated by successful live repair here.

Legacy full/filtered Atlas proposals use maximum plus null, which still compiles to top_k=1; one replacement does not fix scope. Lyra token-frontier truncation is not assessed by the limited grammar and can execute with a valid receipt while failing the task contract.
Full selections may sort by any supported metric/direction and may set include_ties false because no boundary truncation occurs; these are not task failures.
Protocols change prompt, schema and compilation together; this small unblinded synthetic comparison does not isolate a causal field effect or establish a general success rate.
